apps.title: CamStreamEmu
apps.summary: Reproduce a captured camera's video stream (multicast / RTSP / HTTP-MJPEG) from the built-in camera.
apps.description: CamStreamEmu regenerates the video stream of a real network camera from a profile captured by PacketScope. Pick a camera-profile JSON on the 320x170 screen and it encodes the built-in camera to that exact format via GStreamer (hardware H.264 on the Pi) and delivers it the same way the real camera did — multicast RTP (H.264/MPEG2-TS, MPEG-2, MLIT MPEG2-TTS/PT103, RTP-JPEG), an RTSP server, or an HTTP Motion-JPEG server — while showing live delivery mode / destination / packet & byte counters. Video-only; there is no pan/tilt/zoom camera control. Pairs with PacketScope (observe -> reproduce round-trip).

en.title: CamStreamEmu
en.summary: Reproduce a captured camera's video stream (multicast / RTSP / HTTP-MJPEG) from the built-in camera.
en.description: CamStreamEmu regenerates a real network camera's video stream from a profile captured by PacketScope. Pick a camera-profile JSON on the 320x170 screen; it encodes the built-in camera to that exact format via GStreamer (hardware H.264 on the Pi) and delivers it the way the real camera did: multicast RTP (H.264/MPEG2-TS, MPEG-2, MLIT MPEG2-TTS/PT103, RTP-JPEG), an RTSP server, or an HTTP Motion-JPEG server — with live delivery-mode / destination / packet & byte counters. Video only (no PTZF camera control). Pairs with PacketScope as the observe->reproduce round-trip.

ja.title: カムストリームエミュ
ja.summary: 取得したカメラの映像ストリームを内蔵カメラから再現(マルチキャスト/RTSP/HTTP-MJPEG)。
ja.description: CamStreamEmu は、PacketScope で取得したプロファイルから実ネットワークカメラの映像ストリームを再現します。320x170 の画面でカメラプロファイルJSONを選ぶと、内蔵カメラを GStreamer(Piではハードウェア H.264)でその形式に符号化し、実カメラと同じ方式で配信します: マルチキャストRTP(H.264/MPEG2-TS・MPEG-2・国交省MPEG2-TTS/PT103・RTP-JPEG)、RTSPサーバ、HTTP Motion-JPEG サーバ。配信モード・宛先・パケット/バイト数をライブ表示します。映像のみ(PTZFカメラ制御なし)。PacketScope と対で「観測→再現」の往復を成します。

apps.title: cardputerzero-radio
apps.summary: Internet radio with station search, favourites, sleep timer and alarm
apps.description:
Stream internet radio on your CardputerZero.

Ships with a curated station list you can edit, plus live search across the
Radio Browser directory so you can find and save new stations on-device.

- Favourites, and scrolling track titles from stations that broadcast them
- Automatic reconnect when a stream drops
- Sleep timer, and a wake-to-radio alarm
- Record the live stream to the SD card
- Optional boot-to-radio autostart, toggled in Settings
- Tells you plainly when Wi-Fi is missing instead of blaming the station

Driven entirely from the keyboard. SPACE plays, arrows tune and set volume,
/ searches, G opens settings.

Requires an internet connection. Not yet tested on production hardware.

apps.title: ChainLED
apps.summary: Create 8x8 LED animations and drive a real Chain Mono/RGB matrix.
apps.description: CardputerZero Chain LED animation editor & simulator

zh-CN.title: 链式LED模拟器
zh-CN.summary: 创建8x8 LED动画，并驱动真实的Chain Mono/RGB矩阵。
zh-CN.description: 为CardputerZero打造的8x8像素动画编辑器与LED矩阵模拟器。使用键盘绘制最多10帧的动画（支持从第一帧自动生成剩余帧），在屏幕上以RGB或单色模式预览，并可通过UART实时驱动真实的Chain Mono / Chain RGB（M5Stack Chain系列）8x8 LED矩阵。可通过内置蓝牙（BLE，默认）或WiFi局域网与另一台CardputerZero互相发送/接收动画。界面支持简体中文/英语/日语三语切换，随时可在设置中更改并即时生效。

en.title: ChainLED
en.summary: Create 8x8 LED animations and drive a real Chain Mono/RGB matrix.
en.description: An 8x8 pixel-animation editor and LED-matrix simulator built for CardputerZero. Draw up to 10 frames with a keyboard-only editor (with automatic remaining-frame generation from a single seed frame), preview in RGB or Mono mode on-screen, and drive a real Chain Mono / Chain RGB (M5Stack Chain series) 8x8 LED matrix live over UART. Send and receive animations with another CardputerZero over built-in Bluetooth (BLE, the default) or WiFi LAN. The UI switches between English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese instantly from Settings.

ja.title: チェーンLEDシミュレーション
ja.summary: 8x8のLEDアニメーションを作成し、実機のChain Mono/RGBを駆動。
ja.description: CardputerZero向けに作られた、8x8ドットアニメーションエディタ兼LEDマトリクスシミュレータです。キーボード操作のみで最大10コマのアニメーションを作成でき（1枚目のコマから残りを自動生成する機能付き）、画面上でRGB/Monoモードのプレビュー再生ができるほか、実際のChain Mono / Chain RGB（M5Stack Chainシリーズ）8x8 LEDマトリクスにUART経由でリアルタイム出力できます。内蔵Bluetooth（BLE、デフォルト）またはWiFi LAN経由で、もう1台のCardputerZeroとアニメーションを送受信できます。UIは英語・日本語・簡体字中国語を設定画面から即座に切り替え可能です。

apps.title: Location Tracker
apps.summary: LoRa multi-node GPS location receiver — live node list, node detail, and an offline map view.
apps.description: A receiver/display for a LoRa (SX1262) multi-node GPS tracking mesh. Nodes send their position over LoRa; this CardputerZero app shows a live hub view (per-node ID / solution quality / lat-lon / satellites / signal) and a node-detail view (GPS fix, speed, altitude, TX). Radio + GNSS use the M5Stack Cap LoRa-1262 (SX1262 + AT6668/ATGM336H GNSS) — the same cap as the Cardputer ADV — driven on the CM0 via spidev/GPIO, so nodes and hubs interoperate across ADV and CardputerZero. Data arrives as NDJSON on stdin from a LoRa hub over USB-CDC, or from the on-device native LoRa receiver. The SIDE key cycles hub → hub-map → node → node-map, so each mode has both a text screen and a full-screen offline map. The map draws SD-stored offline slippy tiles (no network) with GPS/LoRa positions as markers, a scale bar, and pan/zoom (arrows pan, +/- zoom, 0 recenters): the hub-map auto-fits all received nodes, the node-map follows your own position at the most detail available. A small demo tile set of the Kanto–Chubu region (© GSI Japan / 地理院タイル, credited on-screen) ships with the app so the map self-demos out of the box; point CZ_TILES_DIR at your own tiles (see tools/cztiles) for other areas. Bundles a sample track so the whole app self-demos without hardware. A companion macOS app (native MapKit map view) reads the same LoRa-hub NDJSON stream over USB-CDC/TCP, so the same fleet can be viewed on the Mac at the same time.

apps.title: NetSim
apps.summary: 2-port inline network tester: traffic load-generator + tc netem WAN impairment emulator over the built-in LAN port + one USB-LAN adapter.
apps.description: Turn a two-port CardputerZero (built-in LAN + one USB-LAN adapter) into a portable network lab. LOAD mode blasts self-timestamped frames out port A and receives them raw on port B, measuring one-way latency (min/avg/max), jitter, packet loss, duplication and reorder, plus a binary-search rate sweep that finds the loss-free maximum throughput of the device under test. IMPAIR mode bridges the two ports transparently (no IP needed) and shapes the pass-through traffic per direction with tc netem: delay, jitter, loss, duplicate, corrupt, reorder and rate limiting, with CCTV-tuned presets (Satellite, Congested, Lossy-wireless, Brownout, ...). Every ip/tc/nmcli command is shown in an on-device log. Designed for destructive testing of multicast RTP / MLIT CCTV streams.

apps.title: PacketScope
apps.summary: Offline pcap/pcapng investigator — packet list, protocol tree, hex, filters, RTP & video-stream stats.
apps.description: A fully offline packet-capture investigation tool. Open a .pcap/.pcapng from the SD card and explore it Wireshark-style on the 320x170 screen: a virtualized packet list (No/Time/Src/Dst/Proto/Len/Info), an expandable protocol tree synced to a hex dump with field highlighting, display filters (ip.addr==, udp.port==, rtp.ssrc==, proto keywords, &&/||/!), and statistics: protocol hierarchy, conversations, RTP streams (loss/jitter/rate per SSRC) and a video-stream check (codec/resolution/GOP conformance for CCTV MPEG2-TS/TTS and H.264/MPEG-2). Exports a camera profile (control request + video format) as JSON. Dissectors: Ethernet/VLAN/ARP/IPv4/IPv6/UDP/TCP/ICMP/ICMPv6/IGMP/DNS/DHCP/NTP/RTSP/HTTP/SDP/MJPEG/RTP/MPEG2-TS/TTS(192)/H.264/MPEG-2. Focus protocols: RTSP, MJPEG, TCP, UDP. Includes a bundled sample capture so it self-demos without any setup. Viewer only: no network permission, nothing ever leaves the device.

rendered straight into /dev/fb0. Keys 1-4 switch shapes, W toggles
wireframe, arrows spin, Q quits.

apps.title: Void Notes
apps.summary: Offline Markdown vault for tiny Cardputer screens.
apps.description: Void Notes provides plain-file Markdown notes, search, daily notes, tags, wiki links, and an autosaving keyboard editor for Cardputer Zero.
apps.depends: python3, python3-pil, python3-evdev

apps.title: Void Room
apps.summary: Distraction-free offline writing room tuned for Cardputer Zero.
apps.description: Void Room is a quiet offline writing space for timed focus sessions, with no-exit and no-backspace modes, local session archive, and optional ambient sound.
apps.depends: python3, python3-tk, python3-pil, python3-evdev, alsa-utils

apps.title: Water & Fire
apps.summary: Interactive water and fire simulations that react to every tilt.
apps.description: Turn your CardputerZero into a pocket-sized physics display. Tilt and shake the device to move a volume-preserving water simulation with fluid inertia, or switch to a full-width combustion field where flames and embers bend with gravity while retaining their upward jet. Note: CardputerZero Lite does not include an IMU, so the interactive experience is limited on that model.
apps.depends: libc6, libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libpng16-16, libjpeg62-turbo, zlib1g

apps.title: 爻一爻
apps.summary: 晃动 CardputerZero，以三枚铜钱完成六爻起卦
apps.description: 爻一爻是一款为 CardputerZero 设计的六爻摇卦模拟器。晃动机身驱动三枚铜钱翻滚，也可按 5 键代摇；六次成卦后显示本卦、之卦、卦辞与动爻爻辞。仅供传统文化娱乐体验。
apps.depends: libc6, libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libpng16-16, libjpeg62-turbo, zlib1g

apps.title: zeno-runner
apps.summary: Jump, dodge, and chase high scores in a day-and-night CardputerZero runner.
apps.description: Zeno Runner is a lightweight endless runner designed for CardputerZero. Guide your dinosaur over cacti, duck under flying obstacles, and survive as the game steadily speeds up. The scenery smoothly alternates between day and night, while a local leaderboard records the top three scores. Simple controls make it easy to start, but mastering the timing and rising pace takes sharp reflexes.
apps.depends: libc6, libatomic1, libdrm2

apps.title: Zero MP3
apps.summary: Play local MP3 files with playlist, volume, repeat, and shuffle controls.
apps.description: Zero MP3 is a lightweight local music player for CardputerZero. It scans common music locations such as /home/pi/Music, /media, and /mnt, and can also use ZEROMP3_DIR for a custom music folder.

zh-CN.title: Zero MP3
zh-CN.summary: 播放本地 MP3 文件，支持播放列表、音量、循环和随机播放。
zh-CN.description: Zero MP3 是为 CardputerZero 设计的轻量本地音乐播放器。它会扫描 /home/pi/Music、/media、/mnt 等目录，也支持通过 ZEROMP3_DIR 指定音乐目录。应用提供播放列表、播放/暂停、上一首/下一首、音量调节、循环播放和随机播放等常用控制。

en.title: Zero MP3
en.summary: Play local MP3 files with playlist, volume, repeat, and shuffle controls.
en.description: Zero MP3 is a lightweight local music player for CardputerZero. It scans common music locations such as /home/pi/Music, /media, and /mnt, and can also use ZEROMP3_DIR for a custom music folder. The app provides playlist browsing, play/pause, previous/next, volume adjustment, repeat, and shuffle controls.

ja.title: Zero MP3
ja.summary: ローカル MP3 をプレイリスト、音量、リピート、シャッフル操作で再生します。
ja.description: Zero MP3 は CardputerZero 向けの軽量なローカル音楽プレイヤーです。/home/pi/Music、/media、/mnt などの一般的な音楽フォルダをスキャンし、ZEROMP3_DIR で任意のフォルダも指定できます。プレイリスト表示、再生/一時停止、前後の曲への移動、音量調整、リピート、シャッフル操作に対応します。

apps.title: zeroSDR
apps.summary: Real-time SDR spectrum analyzer and audio demodulator for RTL-SDR devices
apps.description: zeroSDR is a lightweight Software Defined Radio (SDR) receiver optimized for embedded Linux systems with small displays. Features real-time spectrum and waterfall visualization, FM/NFM/AM audio demodulation with AGC and squelch, and direct framebuffer rendering for minimal overhead. Designed for Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and Pi 5 with RTL-SDR dongles.
apps.depends: librtlsdr0, libasound2, libc6
